title: Power-outage readiness planner
dek: A checklist that adapts to your household and cites the agency page behind every item. It never sizes a generator, prescribes medical care or gives wiring or fuel advice. Free, private, works offline.
description: A free outage checklist that adapts to your household, drawn from CDC, FEMA, CPSC and Ready.gov. No generator sizing or medical advice. Private; nothing is saved.
recheck: If the CDC, FEMA, CPSC or Ready.gov revise their outage pages, or at the next quarterly source sweep.

source_use.shelter-fema-power-outage-sheet: Medical-device and medication planning with your doctor; replace refrigerated medicines wording; paper communication plan; supplies for several days; food, water advisory, and vehicle items.
source_use.shelter-ready-disabilities: Priority restoration, treatment facilities, equipment backups and communication cards.
source_use.shelter-cpsc-co: Generator placement and carbon monoxide symptom first response.
source_use.shelter-ready-evacuation: Never connect a generator to the home's electrical system.
source_use.shelter-cdc-heat: Fans below 90 F; air conditioning options; do not stop or change medicines without asking.
source_use.shelter-cdc-power-outage: Flashlights instead of candles; food timings; stay with others if the home is damaged; no gas oven for heat.
source_use.shelter-ready-power-outages: Flashlights, power bank, home phone, community location, medication storage question.
source_use.shelter-ready-heat: Heat-illness signs and cooling items; pets.
source_use.shelter-ready-winter-weather: Extra batteries for radios and flashlights; winter items.
source_use.shelter-ready-shelter: Shelter text line; pets and shelters.
source_use.shelter-ready-tech: Text rather than call; charging; low-power mode.
source_use.shelter-ready-plan-locations: School plans; neighbors and shared buildings.
source_use.shelter-nws-nwr: NOAA Weather Radio description and receiver requirement.
source_use.shelter-usda-fsis-emergencies: Thermometer temperatures, grouping, full freezer, cooler and gel packs, up to 4 hours, never taste food, which perishables to discard after more than 4 hours without power.
source_use.fsis-power-failure: Refrigerator about 4 hours unopened; full freezer about 48 hours (24 if half full).
